I am not sure if there is already a better method of doing so by using the `text.truncate` while construction the `Progress()` class, so I created this.\\r\\n\\r\\n```python\\r\\nclass SizedTextColumn(ProgressColumn):\\r\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"A column containing text.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\r\\n\\r\\n    def __init__(\\r\\n        self,\\r\\n        text_format: str,\\r\\n        style: StyleType = \\\"none\\\",\\r\\n        justify: JustifyMethod = \\\"left\\\",\\r\\n        markup: bool = True,\\r\\n        highlighter: Highlighter = None,\\r\\n        overflow: Optional[OverflowMethod] = None,\\r\\n        width: int = 0,\\r\\n    ) -> None:\\r\\n        self.text_format = text_format\\r\\n        self.justify = justify\\r\\n        self.style = style\\r\\n        self.markup = markup\\r\\n        self.highlighter = highlighter\\r\\n        self.overflow = overflow\\r\\n        self.width = width\\r\\n        super().__init__()\\r\\n\\r\\n    def render(self, task: \\\"Task\\\") -> Text:\\r\\n        _text = self.text_format.format(task=task)\\r\\n        if self.markup:\\r\\n            text = Text.from_markup(_text, style=self.style, justify=self.justify)\\r\\n        else:\\r\\n            text = Text(_text, style=self.style, justify=self.justify)\\r\\n        if self.highlighter:\\r\\n            self.highlighter.highlight(text)\\r\\n        if self.width:\\r\\n            text.truncate(max_width=self.width, overflow=self.overflow, pad=True)\\r\\n        return text\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nMore [here](https://github.com/phcreery/rich)\\r\\n\\r\\n**What problem does it solved for you?**\\r\\n\\r\\nIt makes the visibility of multiple bars with leading text much easier to comprehend.
